description: Second report of the same lab search reflected XSS, written by a different lab analyst with different wording and a differently cased first step.
impact: An attacker could craft a lab link that executes script in a victim browser.
proof_of_concept: Same payload reflected unescaped in the lab search page.
remediation: Encode the search parameter on render.
steps_to_reproduce: Confirm the alert dialog appears in the lab browser
title: Search page runs injected script (second report)
